ui.title: Security & Authentication
ui.subtitle: Manage your manager password, two-factor authentication, active login devices, and review recent account activity.
ui.clarification_desc: Branch operational details are kept separate from your personal manager security credentials.
ui.clarification_branch_info_desc: Library physical address, code, seating capacity, daily shifts, front desk hours, and student Wi-Fi credentials & printable standee QR.
ui.clarification_security_desc: Your personal manager account password, authenticator 2FA setup, active device session monitoring with remote logout, and login audit trails.
ui.password_subheading: Update your manager portal login password. Choose a strong, unique password to prevent unauthorized access.
ui.password_updated_success: Password changed successfully! Keep it confidential.
ui.forgot_password_help: Forgot your current password? Please contact Superadmin to request a temporary reset code.
ui.two_factor_subheading: Add an extra layer of security. In addition to your password, you will be required to enter a 6-digit verification code from your authenticator app.
ui.two_factor_enabled_desc: Your manager account is protected with TOTP authentication via Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
ui.two_factor_disabled_desc: We strongly recommend enabling 2FA to protect branch financial data, student records, and manager operations.
ui.step_1_title: Step 1: Scan QR Code with Authenticator App
ui.step_1_desc: Open Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or Authy on your mobile phone and scan this QR code.
ui.manual_entry_key: Or enter this secret key manually in your app:
ui.step_2_desc: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app to confirm setup.
ui.invalid_2fa_code: Invalid verification code. Please enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
ui.backup_codes_desc: Save these recovery codes in a safe place. If you lose access to your authenticator device, each code can be used once to sign in.
ui.codes_copied_toast: All recovery codes copied to clipboard!
ui.confirm_disable_2fa_desc: Disabling 2FA makes your manager account more vulnerable to unauthorized access. Are you sure you want to proceed?
ui.sessions_subheading: These devices are currently authenticated and active on your Manager account. Revoke any unrecognized or old device immediately.
ui.all_other_sessions_revoked_toast: All other device sessions have been logged out.
ui.confirm_logout_all_title: Log out from all other devices?
ui.confirm_logout_all_desc: This will immediately terminate active sessions on all phones, tablets, and computers except this current browser session.
ui.history_subheading: Review recent login attempts, IP addresses, and device signatures for security auditing.
ui.no_history_records: No login records found for the selected filter.
